name: workbuddy-checkin
description: WorkBuddy 每日积分签到插件。自动读取本机登录态并查询/领取每日 100 积分，支持多账号；对称(sym-v1)与非对称(asym-v1)两种加密信封均可解密。
description_en: Daily credit check-in plugin for WorkBuddy. Reads the local session, checks in and claims the daily 100 credits. Multi-account aware; decrypts both sym-v1 and asym-v1 envelopes.
